comment: Entities were mapped to canonical molecular types using common gene/protein/chemical identifiers. Active/inactive/modified states were treated as the same base protein (no modification terms added to standardized names). Small molecules (Omaveloxolone, Spermidine) were annotated as chemicals. Abstract pathway or process states (DNA_damage, Autophagy states) were labeled unknown because the model represents them as phenomenological species rather than defined molecules. PP2A was kept as a protein entity (generic enzyme) and the PP2A–I2PP2A species was represented as a complex of PP2A + SET (I2PP2A). CK2 was expanded into its common subunits (CSNK2A1, CSNK2A2, CSNK2B) and represented as a complex per the instruction to expand family abbreviations.
